sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the ship target, approved-analysis/formula alternatives, formula operands and direction, expected-value-scaled tolerances, load-case existential constraint at exactly 0.8R in the weakest direction, and the conditional blade-failure status rule. Prior feedback is preserved.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: In the formula branch, compute ?expectedLoad using ?expectedReferenceStrength, not ?reportedReferenceStrength. Keep the separate tolerance check comparing the reported reference strength with its expected value; otherwise a tolerated error in the reported intermediate value improperly propagates into the expected load and can permit a load that does not match the prescribed formula.

Replace the nltl:hasLoadCase property constraint using sh:node with an existential qualified-value constraint: use sh:qualifiedValueShape gen:BladeFailureLoadCaseShape and sh:qualifiedMinCount 1. The current sh:node constraint incorrectly requires every load case linked to the ship to be a blade-failure case at 0.8R in the weakest direction, rather than requiring at least one matching case. Retain the corrected formula behavior from prior feedback: compute ?expectedLoad from ?expectedReferenceStrength while separately tolerance-checking the reported reference strength.

Candidate faithfully encodes the ship target, approved-analysis/formula alternatives, formula operands and direction, expected-value-scaled tolerances, load-case existential constraint at exactly 0.8R in the weakest direction, and the conditional blade-failure status rule. Prior feedback is preserved.
